name: Haze
author: Erin Carter
description: A soft colour field quantised into stepped bands — a drifting haze posterised into discrete tones with a fine ordered-dither stipple softening the edges, like a low-bit gradient catching light. Calm, slightly retro, grainy.

params.label: Drift speed
params.effect: How fast the haze drifts; 0 holds it nearly still.

params.label: Colour bands
params.effect: How many discrete tone bands the field is posterised into; low is chunky and graphic, high is nearly smooth.

params.label: Blob size
params.effect: Influence radius of the colour poles; low keeps tight pools, high spreads broad banks.

params.label: Dither
params.effect: Ordered-dither stipple on the band edges; 0 gives hard posterised contours, high dissolves them into grain.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer pulls the field toward it; 0 ignores the mouse.
